acceptance_finding.conclusion: Component-level sealed-side supervision is present in the candidate training data; target-level filtering alone does not enforce the task stated no-sealed-functions-in-training condition. This is not proof that any exact sealed exam target is in training.
acceptance_finding.criterion: Keep sealed functions out of training by truth table
acceptance_finding.mechanism: selector.make_dreams excludes generated dream expression if its function key is sealed, but dream() picks concepts from unfiltered concepts and sets supervision label[pick] = 1 regardless of whether the selected concept function key lies on sealed side.

limits: The full 30000-dream three-seed training and 900-goal search were not rerun by this reviewer because a deterministic necessary acceptance gate fails.
Sparse-grid key is the defined split key; a stronger exhaustive function truth-table check is desirable if full-domain nonoverlap is claimed.
NO_GAIN is a descriptive result only; no champion promotion or AGI claim.

other_checks.reported_outcome: NO_GAIN, model [2,1,0] vs equal CPU all-concepts [5,1,0] and other-goal examples [2,1,0]

proof_scope: Independent replay of first 1000 accepted dream-generation targets per seed (11,19,29), inspection of frozen source and manifests, candidate hash and pinned source/evidence/checkpoint audits, and 11 freshly passed unit tests. Deterministically falsified the explicit separation requirement for sealed-side concept functions in supervised training labels. Did not run complete 3-seed retraining or all 900 exam problems once this necessary acceptance condition failed. No claim of remeasured model efficacy, and no direct leakage of exact exam-target functions established.
required_fix: Exclude all sealed-side component-function keys from the supervised training concept pool and labels (not just composite target outputs), prove this for full 30000 accepted dreams across all seeds, publish a new frozen manifest and retrain/re-evaluate all seven arms at measured equal total CPU. Keep the existing candidate and previous reviews unchanged.
